name: SGS Société Générale de Surveillance
tagline: The world's leading testing, inspection and certification company
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu est le principal indicateur de performance pour SGS, acteur global de testing et certification.

kpis.explanation_fr: Plus grosse business line SGS : tests/inspection/certification pour transition energetique, securite industrielle, environment monitoring. 33% du CA Groupe.
kpis.explanation_en: Largest SGS business line: TIC services for energy transition, industrial safety, environment monitoring. 33% of Group sales.
kpis.signal: Organic growth +6.5% (FX -4.9%, scope +2.1%). Margin AOI 13.1% vs 12.1% 2024. Driver : Safety double-digit, Inspection robust.

kpis.explanation_fr: Marge operationnelle ajustee du segment Connectivity & Products (19% CA). Plus haute marge des 5 business lines : tests EV/wireless/Hardlines/Softlines/Government.
kpis.explanation_en: Adjusted operating income margin of Connectivity & Products segment (19% sales). Highest margin among 5 business lines: EV/wireless/Hardlines/Softlines/Government testing.
kpis.signal: Top quartile margin TIC sector. Organic growth +6.4% driven EV momentum Asia Pacific + wireless North America.

kpis.explanation_fr: Croissance ventes hors effets de change et acquisitions. KPI cardinal SGS, target Strategy 2027 = mid-to-high single digit. 2025 = 5.6% (target Group financial KPI 5.5%).
kpis.explanation_en: Sales growth excluding FX and acquisitions. SGS flagship KPI, Strategy 2027 target = mid-to-high single digit. 2025 = 5.6% (Group target 5.5%).
kpis.signal: Deceleration depuis 7.5% (2024) mais on track Strategy 2027. Acquisitions +1.7%, FX -5.1%.

kpis.explanation_fr: Marge AOI = KPI top-line profitability SGS. Target 2027 ~16-17%. Plan d'efficacite 150M CHF execute fin 2025 → +70bps en 1 an.
kpis.explanation_en: AOI margin = SGS top-line profitability KPI. 2027 target ~16-17%. CHF 150M efficiency plan fully executed 2025 → +70bps in one year.
kpis.signal: Record historique 16.0% atteint en 2025 grace au plan d'efficacite 150M CHF. STI Exec Committee target 15.5%.

kpis.explanation_fr: FCF / AOI ratio = qualite du business model SGS. Stable 57% en 2024-2025 (vs 37-48% 2022-2023). Driver cle valuation TIC sector.
kpis.explanation_en: FCF / AOI ratio = SGS business model quality. Stable 57% 2024-2025 (vs 37-48% 2022-2023). Key TIC valuation driver.
kpis.signal: FCF record 774M CHF (avant cession HQ Geneve). Cash conversion stabilisee niveau premium TIC.
kpis._specific_to: SGS FCF excellence post efficiency plan

kpis.explanation_fr: ROIC SGS reste a 24% en 2025, niveau premium pour sector TIC asset-light.
kpis.explanation_en: SGS ROIC stable 24% in 2025, premium level for asset-light TIC sector.
kpis.signal: Niveau ROIC excellent malgre M&A active (Strategy 2027). Stable vs 2024.

kpis.explanation_fr: Levier financier SGS. Baisse 1.8x → 1.7x grace a FCF + cession HQ Geneve. Marge confortable vs covenants typiques 3-3.5x.
kpis.explanation_en: SGS financial leverage. Drop 1.8x → 1.7x driven by FCF + Geneva HQ disposal. Comfortable headroom vs typical covenants 3-3.5x.
kpis.signal: Net debt 2566M CHF (-104M vs 2024). Headroom pour M&A roll-up TIC.

risks.description: Risque sur l'intégrité des services rendus (faux résultats de test, certifications erronées). SGS applique une approche multi-couches : contrôle qualité, gouvernance technique, contrôles internes, formation et imputabilité claire au niveau Groupe et Pays.
risks.score_rationale: Position 1A 10-K équivalent ESG/risk section (top risk identifié), langage 'key risk due to the nature of our business', tendance stable, catégorie reputation/regulatory pondérée haut.

risks.description: Diminution de la demande pour les services TIC liée aux cycles économiques, crises industrielles ou structurelles. Mitigation : structure de management réalignée sur les clients locaux + global key account management.
risks.score_rationale: Cité explicitement dans rapport + intégré aux KPIs de rémunération variable Exec Committee. Catégorie macro pondérée moyenne.

risks.description: Risque de réduction d'agilité due à un focus insuffisant marché/client. Mitigation : Global Business Services pour améliorer l'excellence opérationnelle et réduire les délais.
risks.score_rationale: Risque opérationnel mentionné explicitement, lié à STI/LTI metrics.

risks.description: Risques accrus en cybersécurité, protection des données et sécurité physique. Effectivement mitigés via mesures ciblées.
risks.score_rationale: Identifié comme topic à haute importance dans double materiality matrix (Technology & digital innovation), tendance up vu transformation digitale.

risks.description: Disruption technologique défie modèles traditionnels labo et audit, ouvrant simultanément nouvelles opportunités. AI usage limité actuellement.
risks.score_rationale: Mentionné comme défi structurel, mais opportunité aussi. Catégorie business model pondérée moyenne.

risks.description: Risque de violation d'intégrité de services et corruption. Mitigation : zero-tolerance, malus & claw-back policies, Code of Integrity.
risks.score_rationale: Zero-tolerance officielle, KPI rémunération variable lié, catégorie regulatory pondérée haut.

risks.description: Risque de gestion talents inadéquate, attrition compétences clés. Mitigation : développement local skills, regional workforce planning, KPIs attrition.
risks.score_rationale: Topic top-tier dans double materiality matrix.

risks.description: Impact physique des risques climatiques + transition vers sustainability services. Mitigation : KPI LTI Exec Committee inclut LTIR, % femmes leadership, GHG emissions.
risks.score_rationale: Topic key dans materiality matrix, opportunité business (sustainability services en croissance double-digit).

company_description: SGS SA operates as a testing, inspection, and certification company in the Asia Pacific, Europe, North America, Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and America. It operates in two segments, Testing & Inspection and Certification. The company offers testing services, such as crop production testing, agricultural commodities testing, field studies, laboratory studies, seed quality control, and seed research and development; and inspection services, including draft survey and marine services, e-certificates, loading and discharge supervision, pre-shipment inspection, quality and quantity inspection, and tally. It also provides consulting, digital trust assurance, medical devices regulatory compliance, product certification, supply chain assurance, sustainability assurance, and verification and assurance, as well as assessment, auditing, and certification services; and professional training services. The company serves agriculture and forestry, building and infrastructure, consumer products and retail, cosmetics and personal care, cybersecurity and technology, environmental, health and safety, food, government and trade facilitation, industrial manufacturing and processing, MedTech, mining, oil, gas and chemicals, pharma, power and utilities, and transportation industries. SGS SA was founded in 1878 and is headquartered in Baar, Switzerland.
